div.head: Cn 1018 13
div.ab: 7 gelæste man godes gerihta georne. rihtlice æghwilce geare.
And gelæste man Godes gerihta georne rihtlice æghwilce geare.
And ecclesiastical dues should be paid properly every year.
And God’s dues are to be paid readily every year.
